OLED bell-tree.wav, bell-minecraft.wav, bell-coast.wav, bell-railway.wav:
Original synthesized short chimes created for this project. MIT, see repository LICENSE.

bell-fanfare.wav and bell-comic.wav:
Spring Spring: The War Over A Melon Field - Themes and Jingles (2019), CC0.
Source: https://opengameart.org/content/the-war-over-a-melon-field-themes-and-jingles
Original files: win_1.ogg (win fanfare), charselect_2.ogg (charselect).
Adaptations: excerpted to 8 seconds, loudness normalization, fade in/out.
The source credits a bicycle horn sound to AntumDeluge.
License: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

No YouTube audio, commercial songs or voice clones are included in the bell package.
